180. Hybrid Sort of an Array

Problem Statement:
Given an array N, sort it in ascending order till it reaches kth elements and after that sort it in descending order.
input_spec: The input consists of two integers N and K on the first line, followed by N integers representing the array elements on the second line. N <= 100000.
output_spec: The output should be the modified array after applying the specified sorting logic.
